test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. Plants need sunlight, water and nutrients to grow.
2. So, we must take care of our plants by providing them with the right conditions.
3. Without these essential elements, plants would not survive.
4. Then, our plants will be healthy and produce flowers and fruits.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To form a meaningful paragraph, it is essential to identify the logical flow of ideas and ensure that the sentences connect coherently.
 
• **Sentence 1** introduces the essential elements required for plant growth:
 
 
• "Plants need sunlight, water and nutrients to grow."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3** logically follows, as it explains the consequence of not having these essential elements:
 
 
• "Without these essential elements, plants would not survive."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2** builds on this idea by emphasizing the need to take care of plants:
 
 
• "So, we must take care of our plants by providing them with the right conditions."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4** concludes the paragraph by describing the outcome of taking care of plants:
 
 
• "Then, our plants will be healthy and produce flowers and fruits."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **1-3-2-4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Plants need sunlight, water and nutrients to grow. Without these essential elements, plants would not survive. So, we must take care of our plants by providing them with the right conditions. Then, our plants will be healthy and produce flowers and fruits."</div
